seeds.sg-4-2-0-0: Beside a whistling basalt cairn, you coax your wounded lamp back to life while glass-dust scours your chapped knuckles.
seeds.sg-4-2-0-1: In a dry ditch of green bottle-shards, you press the cold Seedkey to your ribs as the howling gale seeks your breath.
seeds.sg-4-2-1-0: Beneath a crescent of fused sand, you mend a cracked chimney with tallow and grit while the tempest thrums overhead.
seeds.sg-4-2-1-1: Within a hollow glass skull, you wait out a blinding micro-burst, clutching your soot-blackened lantern against the rising chill.
seeds.sg-4-2-1-2: Walking unguided, you spot a dry drainage pipe choked with amber beads that shields your fragile flame from the screaming drift.
seeds.sg-4-2-1-3: Behind a tumbled arch of blue slag, you bind your burned fingers with hempen cloth while the gale strips the dunes.
seeds.sg-4-2-1-4: In the lee of a massive bell-jar fragment, you feed precious scrap-coal to your sputtering wick as the night turns abrasive.
seeds.sg-4-2-1-5: Across a ribbed crust of salt-pimple flats, you run low and hard, praying your singed wick holds its yellow spark.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-0: Through a corridor of singing telegraph-wire, you dodge whipping glass reeds while your lamp casts long, stuttering shadows.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-1: Bound by the sisters' well-oath, you recognize a hidden alkali spring beneath the drift that cools your scorched palm and feeds your resolve.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-2: Under a ledge of milk-white slag, a shivering nomad named Nola trades a handful of coarse salt for a drop of water.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-3: Past a reef of jagged prisms, you scramble over shifting dunes, your breath rattling in a throat parched by microscopic grit.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-4: In a sunken bowl of black obsidian, you shield your lantern glass from a sudden flurry of razor-sharp diamond dust.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-5: Beside a half-buried water-hoop, you check the Seedkey for hairline fractures caused by the violent, scouring gale.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-6: Through a labyrinth of hollow glass pipes, you trace a steady hum that guides your blistered feet toward Prism's distant towers.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-7: Under a canopy of glittering scree, an old salt-weaver named Voss warns you of bottomless sinkholes hidden beneath the dust-whirls.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-8: Across a shimmering crust of sulphate, you sprint through a squall of diamond needles, keeping your shoulder turned to the biting wind.
seeds.sg-4-2-2-9: Inside a hollowed cistern rim, you scrape fine glass-powder from your coat hem before it works its way to your raw skin.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-0: Beneath a listing wind-vane spire, you steady your trembling lamp as the gale shifts from a shriek to a low, melodic drone.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-1: Across an expanse of violet mirror-shards, you follow a trail of charred wooden pegs left by an earlier, desperate traveler.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-2: Within a hollow dune of crystal meal, you pause to scrape crusted salt from your eyelashes so you can trace the horizon.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-3: Beside a frozen cataract of greenish glass, a lone scout named Garrow points toward a smoother trench cutting through the storm-waste.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-4: Through a choking veil of mica flakes, you feel the Seedkey thrum with a faint, damp chill against your burning breastbone.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-5: Under a shattered vault of stained glass, you clean your lamp-lens with a corner of your cloak while the wind beats the ruins.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-6: Across a ridge of calcified foam, you slide into a deep drainage furrow that spares your burning eyes from the stinging squall.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-7: Inside a hollow pipe of burnt earthenware, you listen to the storm whistle like an organ while you check your meager fuel.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-8: Beneath a tilted arch of fused quartz, a weary scavenger named Miri trades a dry crust for a momentary glimpse of your ember.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-9: Through a dense drift of glittering sand, you forge ahead with your teeth clenched, ignoring the deep ache in your scorched palms.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-10: Traveling alone, you notice a narrow drainage culvert free of drift-piles that lets you bypass the worst of the howling gale.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-11: Across a plateau of grey basalt tiles, you fight for every stride against a wall of air thick with pulverized mirror-dust.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-12: Inside a hollowed bowl of slag-iron, you tend your flickering flame while the tempest rattles the metal plates overhead.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-13: Beneath a drooping wire-mesh awning, a weathered courier named Hale nods once before disappearing into the blinding white dust-sea.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-14: Through a maze of upright glass stakes, you pick your path with agonizing care to protect your sole remaining box of matches.
seeds.sg-4-2-3-15: Over a swelling dune of fine salt-crust, you surge toward the dark silhouette of Prism's outer wall looming through the murk.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-0: Beside a colossal brass gear half-swallowed by sand, you catch your breath as the mirror storm begins its slow, ragged dying.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-1: Under a towering arch of green bottle-glass, you check your ember-lamp one last time before stepping onto the dry approach.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-2: Across a wide apron of smooth white flagstones, you stride away from the scouring gale toward the quiet shadow of the observatory.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-3: Within a ditch of fused slag-blocks, you shake the last stubborn grains of crystal dust from the folds of your tattered traveling cloak.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-4: Beside a rusted sluice-gate wheel, you press your hand against the cold Seedkey and feel the vibration of distant subterranean machinery.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-5: Under a low lintel of dark basalt, a lone glasswright named Thistle signals with a brief flash of a mirror-shard that the path is clear.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-6: Across a ribbed terrace of old salt-pans, you leave the screaming mirror storm behind and step into the silent precinct of Prism's base.
seeds.sg-4-2-4-7: Within the shadow of Prism's massive cyclopean masonry, you steady your weary limbs and prepare to face the final gate of the vault.
seeds.sg-4-2-5-0: Before the great bronze wicket of the Rain Vault, you hold up your steady ember-lamp to prove the flame survived the scouring Basin.
seeds.sg-4-2-5-1: Against the frost-etched panels of the inner door, you raise the heavy Seedkey as the air grows cool and damp with subterranean promise.
seeds.sg-4-2-5-2: Between the towering pillars of the observatory, you watch the last swirls of mirror-dust settle into the cracks of the ancient flagstones.
seeds.sg-4-2-5-3: Upon the threshold of the deep seed-halls, you draw a long, clean breath of damp earth as your journey through the salt-waste ends.
seeds.sg-d-4-2: Attempting to outrun the howling mirror storm without shielding your lamp, you stumble into a pit of razor-sharp cullet that drains your lifeblood in the dark.
